Here’s what changed in `style.css`:

- **Page**: `html { color-scheme: dark; }` so the browser treats the page as dark; body uses `#0d1117` background and `#e6edf3` text.
- **Borders & muted text**: Header/footer dividers and secondary copy use `#30363d` / `#8b949e` so contrast stays clear on dark UI.
- **Links**: Accent updated to `#58a6ff` so links stay readable on the dark background.
- **Gallery cards**: Cards use `#161b22`, a light `#30363d` border, and deeper shadows; hover slightly lifts the card and brightens the border.

No HTML updates were required. Refresh the page to see the dark theme.
